S1.rule: primary beats the best source-free or sparse estimator in >= 90% of source-proximal cells and loses in none

S2.rule: primary non-inferior (upper bound < +0.2 dB) to the group-sparse and the cap-5 region kernel in every source-proximal cell, and pooled superior to each

S3.rule: cross-validated order beats one point in both two-source cells (points, shared coordinates)

S4.rule: extension loses in no source-proximal cell and is pooled superior to points

S5.rule: shared coordinates win in >= half of the source-proximal cells, lose in none, and are pooled superior to per-bin fitting

S6.rule: primary never loses to the source-free sinc kernel (all cells, far control included)
